categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Baoli International Investment Co., Ltd. primarily operates in two main segments: professional asphalt production and sales, and general aviation services including helicopter sales, leasing, and maintenance. The company also engages in financing leasing and BT (Build-Transfer) project investments. Asphalt products serve road construction and maintenance, while aviation services focus on emergency rescue and forestry protection.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies in asphalt modification, including SBS, SBR, EVA, and PE modified asphalts, as well as polymer-modified emulsified asphalts. It invests in R&D for new materials such as recycled rubber-based thermoplastic elastomers and silica composite modified asphalt. Production methods emphasize quality control, environmental protection, and innovation in road materials, supported by collaborations with top Chinese universities and research institutes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large state-owned highway construction units, municipal road projects, and infrastructure developers. The company serves domestic markets extensively, especially in East, Central, Southwest, and Northwest China, and exports to overseas markets such as Russia and Africa. Aviation customers include government emergency management agencies and forestry departments requiring helicopter services and parts.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production facilities in Jiangsu, Shaanxi, Hunan, Sichuan, Tibet, and Xinjiang provinces. It also has overseas subsidiaries in Singapore and Russia. Its sales and service networks cover major domestic regions and selected international markets, aligning with China's Belt and Road Initiative.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Baoli International is positioned mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the asphalt supply chain, producing and supplying modified asphalt products and providing integrated supply chain services including procurement, storage, processing, and distribution. In aviation, it acts as an authorized dealer and service provider, covering sales, leasing, maintenance, and parts supply.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on technological innovation in asphalt materials, emphasizing environmentally friendly and high-performance products. R&D priorities include developing recycled rubber-based elastomers, silica composite modified asphalts, functional road materials, and low-temperature paving materials. It also invests in aviation industry chain integration, expanding helicopter sales, leasing, and maintenance services to support national emergency and forestry aviation needs.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of asphalt materials and aviation equipment, leasing and operation of aircraft, and provision of related services such as maintenance and parts supply. The company also earns income from BT project investments and financial leasing. It employs direct sales and strategic partnerships to secure contracts, including bidding for large infrastructure projects and government aviation contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The asphalt industry in China is highly fragmented with many small-scale producers; Jiangsu Baoli International ranks among the leading companies in production capacity and supply chain integration but holds a relatively small market share. The company differentiates itself through comprehensive supply chain services and technological innovation. In aviation, it is a designated authorized dealer for Russian helicopters in China, positioning itself as a key player in the domestic general aviation market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately 1.97 billion RMB, a decrease of 8.23% from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about 22.3 million RMB, recovering from losses in prior years. Total assets stood at 1.71 billion RMB, with equity of 964.7 million RMB. The company has shown a turnaround in profitability through cost control and strategic adjustments despite industry challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Baoli International emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced asphalt products with strong brand recognition in East China. It offers integrated supply chain solutions, including procurement, storage, processing, logistics, and financial services, providing customers with one-stop service. In aviation, it leverages exclusive agency rights and comprehensive after-sales support to deliver reliable helicopter solutions tailored to emergency and forestry applications, enhancing customer value through service excellence and innovation.
